cases.wallet_observed_failure: refresh returned daemon error; no crash
cases.recovery: consecutive refreshes converged to coinbase*reward after the node stopped refusing

boundary: wallet -> recording forwarding proxy (untrusted node) -> daemon; --network none

observed_exposure.note: Metadata the node/on-path observer actually saw in this run.

hypotheses_not_tested: On a real network the node sees the operator public IP, not 127.0.0.1, unless Tor/I2P is used (not deployed or tested here).
Repeated get_outs/get_transactions patterns narrow wallet-owned outputs by intersection over time; not quantified here.
Timing/traffic-analysis resistance and Dandelion++ relay origin hiding are not evaluated.
sanitization: records hold method/path/size/sha256/client/time only; no bodies, mnemonic, keys, or addresses; asserted by scan_for_secrets().
scope: selected 9/90 real daemon+wallet; isolated fixed-difficulty chain; disposable keys; one denial/recovery correlation; not an anonymity or Tor/I2P test.
